mug_felix: Previous note said coffee_table_l1, but Day 15 07:34 feedback showed kitchen_table_k1. It seems to be in the kitchen in the early morning. Check kitchen_table_k1 for morning hours, coffee_table_l1 for later.

tablet_felix: Highly mobile. Day 15 07:35 was kitchen_table_k1, 09:59 was coffee_table_l1, but 21:07 was bed_b1. It moves from kitchen to living room during the day and to the bedroom at night. Check bed_b1 for late evening, coffee_table_l1 for mid-day, kitchen_table_k1 for early morning.

book_felix: Day 15 11:52 feedback confirmed coffee_table_l1. Previous note to check coffee_table_l1 for daytime locations remains correct.

water_bottle_felix: Day 16 19:10 feedback showed kitchen_table_k1, contradicting the assumption that it stays in the living room in the evening. It appears to move to the kitchen in the late afternoon/evening. Check kitchen_table_k1 for evening hours, coffee_table_l1 for mid-day.

razor_felix: Day 16 07:00 feedback confirmed bathroom_shelf_ba1, correcting the previous guess of sink_ba_ba1. The morning location is consistently the shelf. Check bathroom_shelf_ba1 first in the morning.

glass_felix: No new errors today. Previous note to check nightstand_b1 for late-night locations remains relevant.

charger_felix: Day 16 12:59 feedback showed coffee_table_l1, contradicting the guess of desk_b1. It remains in the living room during the day. Check coffee_table_l1 for daytime locations.
